Category: Unseen Gods

Primarily Worshipped In: Freke, Isles of Mann, Noraki, Bahljet, Pockets worldwide

Espirian Domains: The Heavens (Paradia, Khuldin, Elysium, Baythal, Valtal, Asphalus, Taranthara)

Dhusamat’s primary tenets are for community, thought, human rights, love, unity, and faith. Social development, cooperation and culture is a large pillar of the faith, where mankind is encouraged to see each other as simply that: people. As such, ensuring that people are treated equally and that they are not oppressed, and that communities are built through kindness and cooperation form the basis of many Dhusamat-worshipping societies.

Title The Golden Light

Edicts Build your communities, champion the rights of people, show kindness and respect to others

Anathema Disrespect your loved ones, distort faith to commit harm

Areas of Concern Community, Love, Respecting culture and tradition

Religious Symbol A streak of light upon a night sky, with the sun, moon and a star in the background

Sacred Animal Goat

Sacred Colors gold and white
